requiredBeforePublic: Obtain independent approval of the exact hash-bound attract, aim, cue-contact, motion, pocket, foul, rack-fail, eight-ball finish, mobile, and reduced-motion artifacts.
Retain fresh 18-model asset probes, route-primary, route-health, deploy, performance, and source-bound browser evidence after that approval.
Promote a public showcase card only after the Bank Shot PRD ledger records the independent verdict.
evidence: tests/reports/bank-shot/browser-evidence.json binds the exact desktop, mobile, interaction, outcome, and reduced-motion artifact family to current route and producer source.
tests/reports/bank-shot/playable/browser-evidence.json binds naturally driven public-Rapier shots, settle lock, pause, and reset to current route source.
apps/showcase-bank-shot/route-health.json must retain publicShowcase false and the pending-review blocker.
